label: bug

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever PUBLIC_URL isn't set in the environment, so password reset (and other) emails link to localhost in production. A PR has been opened to ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/required for production deployments so emails use the correct public domain.

input.title: Fix password reset emails linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being hit in production, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost instead of the real site.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set correctly in the production environment/deployment configuration, and make the code fail loudly instead of silently falling back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is missing outside of local development (e.g. throw or log an error if PUBLIC_URL is unset and NODE_ENV is "production"). This will make misconfiguration visible immediately rather than producing broken links in emails like the password reset message.
